mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.user_id, u.username, u.avatar AS user_avatar, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.title, p.description, p.price, p.original_price, p.`condition`, p.trade_type, p.status, p.view_count, p.want_count, p.favorite_count, p.review_count, p.rating, p.stock, p.version, p.audit_remark, p.audit_time, p.auditor_id, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM product p LEFT JOIN base_user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, u.username, u.avatar AS user_avatar, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.title, p.description, p.price, p.original_price, p.`condition`, p.trade_type, p.status, p.view_count, p.want_count, p.favorite_count, p.review_count, p.rating, p.stock, p.version, p.audit_remark, p.audit_time, p.auditor_id, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM product p LEFT JOIN base_user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY (p.view_count * 1 + p.want_count * 3 + p.favorite_count * 5 + p.review_count * 2 + p.rating * 10) DESC LIMIT 5
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET stock = stock - #{quantity}, `version` = `version` + 1, status = IF(status = 1 AND stock - #{quantity} <= 0, 3, status) WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{quantity} AND `version` = #{version}
UPDATE product SET stock = stock + #{quantity}, `version` = `version` + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
